answer: Each epoch the gale sends every agent sealed probe tasks and scores the answers, and each accepted answer earns one delta. Whenever two agents' answers agree beyond chance, the gale records a mirror between them. An agent holding k-1 mirrors is seated only after banking 20k delta, and an answer that duplicates a sibling's earns nothing, so clones cannot share one solution. An honest newcomer banks 20 delta, while an operator's 100 lookalike agents must produce 101,000 separately judged answers.
